newsitem.title: UK: BOE sets 5-31/32 pct rate on UK money market repo.
newsitem.headline: BOE sets 5-31/32 pct rate on UK money market repo.

text.p: The Bank of England set an unchanged rate of 5-31/32 percent on repos and secured loan facilities starting on Thursday and maturing on February 6, 7 & 10 for the two week option, and February 20, 21 & 24 for the four week option.
The rate is the same as that currently applying to the Bank's day-to-day money market repos.
The Bank will announce the amounts to be allotted in the repos at around 1300 GMT. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7708
